data.title: IMF chief urges Asean states to do more for the vulnerable
data.description: The International Monetary Fund has urged Southeast Asian governments to protect vulnerable households, pursue economic reforms and deepen regional cooperation to strengthen resilience against global economic shocks.

data.title: Macron: French protesters ‘exploited’ by political forces
data.description: PARIS - French President Emmanuel Macron believes students waging three weeks of protests that have closed many schools have “legitimate” grievances but are also being “exploited” by political forces, a government spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

data.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosque in West Bank
data.description: MIKHMAS, Palestinian Territories - Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque and graffitied its outside walls on Wednesday in the occupied West Bank village of Mikhmas, Palestinian sources and the Israeli military said.

data.title: Global anti-fraud plan unveiled
data.description: The International Monetary Fund and World Bank have unveiled a global roadmap to help countries prevent, detect and tackle the growing threat of cyber-enabled fraud in digital financial services.

data.title: Drone hits data centre of Russia’s largest bank
data.description: MOSCOW - A drone hit a data centre belonging to the Russian state-owned lender Sberbank, a company executive said Wednesday, though the bank’s systems and services were operating normally.

data.title: Pope recovering after lung cancer operation
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV began post-surgery recovery on Wednesday after a tumour removed from his lung was found to be cancerous, plunging the Catholic Church into a period of uncertainty.

data.title: State auditors query Thai PBS contracts
data.description: The State Audit Office (SAO) has expressed suspicions about the way Thai Public Broadcasting Service hires and pays programme producers, saying it is evading payment rules.

data.title: Cities That Win the Future Will Be Built for Life, Not Just Growth
data.description: Leaders from Bangkok, Hong Kong and Copenhagen tell CNN Global Perspectives that talent, visitors and investment follow a city's soul, not its skyline

data.title: Sansiri Capital completes the acquisition of The Lake Como EDITION,
data.description: Sansiri Capital completes the acquisition of “The Lake Como EDITION,” an ultra-luxury hotel on the shores of Lake Como, Italy.

data.title: Indonesian haze causes spike in Singapore pollution
data.description: SINGAPORE - Air pollution in parts of Singapore hit the country’s “very high” band on Wednesday while Timor-Leste shut schools, as haze from forest fires raging in Indonesia causes a regional crisis.

data.title: Generali, World Bank Group partner on insurance, resilience and investment in emerging markets
data.description: Generali and the World Bank Group (WBG) have recently signed a Memorandum of Understanding during the Annual Meetings of the WBG and the International Monetary Fund in Bangkok , built on a shared commitment to mobilise private capital, strengthen resilience and expand targeted insurance and investment solutions across emerging markets.

data.title: Fuel shortage triggers queues on Bali
data.description: DENPASAR, Indonesia - Moldovan tourist Raisa Neagu spent hours on Wednesday waiting to fuel up her scooter, one of many people snared in a petrol shortage on resort island Bali that authorities blamed on supply disruptions.

data.title: Chut Thai on Cusp of UNESCO Recognition as Princess Sirivannavari Champions Living Heritage on World Stage
data.description: Thailand awaits a UNESCO decision as a CNN Global Perspectives panel hails Queen Sirikit's legacy and Princess Sirivannavari's work for Thai craft

data.title: High-water alert at Khlong Luang Phaeng in Bangkok
data.description: Residents living along Khlong Luang Phaeng in eastern Bangkok have been urged to monitor water levels closely after the Royal Irrigation Department agreed to open the canal’s sluice gate, with levels expected to rise starting from 3.30pm on Wednesday.

data.title: Thai Airways offers new help after baggage crisis
data.description: Thai Airways International is stepping up compensation to restore passenger confidence after major flooding disrupted services, leaving 25,000 bags stranded and forcing more than 200 flight cancellations.

data.title: Thai woven bags draw interest at IMF–World Bank 2026
data.description: Souvenir bags made from Khu Bua textiles in Ratchaburi took almost a year to prepare, pairing traditional Thai weaving with contemporary design.

data.title: ibank Unites Global Islamic Finance Leaders to Unlock New Opportunities for Thailand and ASEAN
data.description: The Islamic Bank of Thailand (ibank) convened leaders, financial institution executives, and Islamic finance experts from Thailand and abroad at the international forum “Islamic Finance: From Crisis Resilience to Transition Finance.” Building on Thailand’s hosting theme, “Thailand’s New Horizons: Empowering People, Building Resilience,” the forum explored how Islamic finance can strengthen economic resilience, mobilize capital for sustainable transitions, and unlock new opportunities for Thailand and ASEAN. A key highlight was a keynote address by the Chairman of the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Group, who shared his vision for the future of Islamic finance, emphasizing strong governance, institutional integrity, and sustainable development.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty eyes Muay Thai title return ahead of Akimoto defence
data.description: British champion Jonathan Haggerty wants to reclaim ONE Championship’s bantamweight Muay Thai title if he comes through Saturday’s kickboxing defence against Japanese challenger Hiroki Akimoto in Tokyo.

data.title: Family of girl, 7, donates organs and corneas after fatal accident
data.description: The family of a seven-year-old girl from Trang who died in an accident has donated her organs and corneas to help others waiting for transplants, the Thai Red Cross Society said on Wednesday.

data.title: Zelensky accuses Putin of disrespecting Trump
data.description: KYIV - Ukraine on Wednesday accused Russia of wilfully flouting Donald Trump’s purported “energy ceasefire” and passing up an opportunity to ease hostilities, after a renewed wave of deadly strikes across the country that also hit vital power supplies.

data.title: China-North Korea bridge to open 12 years late
data.description: BEIJING - A new bridge linking China and North Korea will finally open on Thursday, 12 years after its construction, with Beijing vowing it will spur trade and “enhance the well-being of the two peoples”.

data.title: TBS & World Bank Group Co-Host Youth AI Summit in Bangkok
data.description: BANGKOK, 12 October 2026 — Thammasat Business School (TBS) took the global stage at the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group (WBG) in Bangkok, co-hosting a high-level youth event with the World Bank Group to explore the future of jobs, artificial intelligence and economic opportunities for the next generation.

data.title: Building Beyond the Museum: Why Culture Is Coming Closer to Home
data.description: Marisa Chearavanont and Kulapat Yantrasast tell CNN Global Perspectives that museums matter most when they heal, gather and welcome everyone

data.title: ‘Papyrus 20’ scent is for all the readers
data.description: Le Labo has released Papyrus 20, a new scent joining the Classic Candle collection of the famous “slow perfumery” brand. Inspired by the ancient material used to preserve stories for generations to come, Papyrus 20 explores the ephemeral nature of scent and memories.

data.title: FM Sihasak says Chinese airfield in Laos poses no immediate concern
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has played down concerns over a Chinese airport project in Laos, about 50km from the Thai border, saying it has not raised any immediate concerns for Thailand.

data.title: Trump touts ‘massive’ oil and mineral exploration in Greenland
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump said Wednesday that oil, gas and mineral exploration was preparing to begin in Greenland, and hailed the Arctic island’s position for US and European security.

data.title: Indian ‘cockroach’ leaders sent to jail after protest
data.description: NEW DELHI - Two leaders of India’s youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) were remanded in custody for five days on Wednesday, as police racheted up efforts to clamp down on anti-election commission protests.

data.title: Three Prachin Buri factories face toxins probe
data.description: Three factories in Prachin Buri have been ordered to suspend operations following suspected toxic chemical leaks that caused water pollution during flooding, while investigations into alleged nominee ownership and “a prominent surname” involved are also under way.

data.title: Deluge by design: Thai villages flooded to protect capital
data.description: AYUTTHAYA - Stilt houses in villages north of Bangkok are no longer high enough to stay dry as Thai authorities deliberately flood riverside communities to spare the capital.

data.title: Chao Phraya Dam discharge rate reduced further
data.description: A gradual reduction in the water discharge rate from the Chao Phraya Dam in Chai Nat from 1,900 to 1,800 cubic metres per second will be completed by 7pm on Wednesday, the Royal Irrigation Department (RID) said.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rifdean ‘101 per cent’ confident of Nadaka knockout in Tokyo title bid
data.description: Malaysian challenger Rifdean Masdor says he is “101 per cent” confident of knocking out Nadaka Yoshinari when he bids to end the Japanese champion’s seven-year unbeaten run and take his ONE Championship atomweight Muay Thai world title on Saturday.

data.title: Turning AI Investment into Shared Opportunities for Thais
data.description: By Sigve Brekke | Group CEO, True Corporation Public Company Limited

data.title: Nene Royal sets Singapore stage ablaze with Avenged Sevenfold
data.description: Thai singer and guitarist Nene Royal joined Avenged Sevenfold for two songs in Singapore after opening the concert with a five-song solo set.

data.title: 5 Must-See Highlights at CP Innovation Exposition 2026
data.description: If you could step into tomorrow before everyone else, what would you want to discover first? Breakthrough technologies once confined to imagination, ideas that could transform businesses, or innovations that could make everyday life better? There is no need to choose. All these experiences are coming together at CP Innovation Exposition 2026, the 9th edition of Charoen Pokphand Group’s Bua Ban Innovation Showcase. For three days, True Digital Park will be transformed into “Future Fest”, bringing technology, creativity and excitement together under the theme “RISE TOGETHER INNOVATE BEYOND”. Everyone is invited to explore new possibilities through five must-see highlights best experienced firsthand.

data.title: IMF chief says Saudi attacks could have negative spillover 'everywhere'
data.description: International Monetary Fund head Kristalina Georgieva said Wednesday that recent attacks on Saudi Arabia could impact people "everywhere", as conflict in the energy-rich region adds to wide-ranging economic concerns.

data.title: AI could make personalised financial advice more affordable
data.description: At a Bangkok forum, GCash and Growhill Wealth leaders highlight AI’s potential to expand financial services without replacing human judgement.

data.title: Ukraine ex-military officer to stand trial over Nord Stream sabotage
data.description: HAMBURG - A former Ukrainian military officer is set to become the first person to stand trial over the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings as proceedings began in a German court Wednesday.

data.title: China heads for record trade surplus as exports surge
data.description: BEIJING - China's exports soared in September, official data showed Wednesday, putting it on course for a record annual trade surplus -- and likely more friction with the European Union and the United States.
